Priya A. (AE): Heads-up — VentureCare board asked for final network and cost answers for the pilot today. They can't sign until we confirm encryption-at-rest + egress pricing for EU region. Also CISO wants confirmation we can BYOK via their Azure Key Vault.

Marco R. (Solutions): Thanks. Short answers: 1) We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) in Private deployments; for Hosted we offer KMS integration with limited attestations. 2) Egress depends on route — if traffic stays in EU region it's lower; cross-region egress billed per GB. I'll fetch numbers.

Li Wei (Eng): For Dedicated we can pin region to eu-west-1 and enforce private peering. Latency estimate for their 2k qps workload w/ batching: p95 ~ 120ms given current profile. Need model size + avg tokens.

Priya A. (AE): They plan 15k monthly queries, avg 60 tokens per request. Can we get a quick cost calc for hosted vs dedicated + rough discount for 12mo commit?

Marco R. (Solutions): Hosted rough: token-based + standard egress. Dedicated: flat reserved hourly + lower per-token cost + egress same. I'll post a short spreadsheet in 30m. @Tanya can legal confirm whether BYOK contract clause is feasible?

Tanya G. (Legal): BYOK okay, but customer wants HSM attestation and key custody audit logs. We'll need SOC2 KMS evidence + addendum. I can draft clause but will need customer PoC scope.

Sam S. (SRE): Quick note: VPC peering + private IP routing adds some prep time (we usually need a week for network handshakes). If they need rapid start, can offer temporary VPN with IP allowlist.

Priya A. (AE): Boardroom wants "no blockers" by EOD. Is there an exec fallback we can offer? Like short-term dedicated trial with constrained SLA?

Marco R. (Solutions): We can do a 2-week dedicated trial on a small reserved pool with a written uptime target and rollback. Need CS + Finance signoff. @Finance-bot please flag for priority quoting.

Finance-bot: Quote request received for VentureCare — prioritizing. Expected deliverable: draft quote + delta pricing within 4 hours.

Tanya G. (Legal): I'll prep a KMS addendum template and mark items needing customer input. ETA 3 hours.

Li Wei (Eng): I'll spin a quick perf run on small dedicated cluster to confirm p95 numbers. ETA 2 hours.

Priya A. (AE): Great. Action owners: Marco => pricing spreadsheet & trial plan; Li Wei => perf run; Tanya => legal addendum; Sam => network runbook for peering/VPN. I'll coordinate with customer and schedule 3pm sanity check.

Marco R. (Solutions): Added: include option for byok via Azure Key Vault and note any extra attestation fees.

Sam S. (SRE): One more — if they want TLS mutual auth, we can enable but might need cert provisioning from their infra team.

Priya A. (AE): Noted. I'll ping customer to prep certs. Also: please include a concise one-pager for board: "what's needed and by when" — Marco can you draft?

Marco R. (Solutions): On it. I'll drop a 1-pager + spreadsheet in this thread in ~45m. :thumbsup: 

Priya A. (AE): Thanks team — flag any blockers here. If we get signoff today we'll fast-track onboarding.

ops-bot: Reminder — network peering requests require ticket with network team. Link: https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/new

Priya A. (AE): Filing ticket now. I'll update thread with ticket ID when done.
